milestones.title: M0: Foundation
milestones.description: Monorepo, launcher, auth, tenancy, audit, roles, docs and development seed.

milestones.title: M1: Catalog and configuration
milestones.description: Products, CSV import, configurable options, incompatibilities and bundles (FR-01, FR-03, FR-04).

milestones.title: M2: Pricing
milestones.description: Money primitives, pricing engine, approval policy, price books and pricing rules (FR-02, FR-05, FR-07).

milestones.title: M3: Customers and quotes
milestones.description: Customer directory, quote families, immutable versions, server-side calculation and lifecycle (FR-06, FR-07).

milestones.title: M4: Approvals
milestones.description: Sequential approval steps, decisions with optimistic locking, inbox and decision screens (FR-08).

milestones.title: M5: Proposal and customer portal
milestones.description: Printable proposal, explicit customer grants and acknowledgment (FR-09).

milestones.title: M6: Reporting, notifications and audit
milestones.description: Dashboard, reports, CSV export, notifications, expiry job and audit timeline (FR-10).

milestones.title: M7: Acceptance and release
milestones.description: PRD section 9 Playwright acceptance suite, accessibility, branding uploads and deployment packaging.

tickets.title: Bootstrap monorepo, run.sh launcher and CI pipeline
tickets.description: Create the npm-workspaces monorepo (api, web, shared), the single run.sh entry point and the GitHub Actions pipeline. A fresh clone must reach a running app with one command.
acceptanceCriteria: ./run.sh on a fresh clone installs deps, creates .env and the database, migrates, seeds and starts API and web
./run.sh check runs lint, format check, typecheck, unit and integration tests
CI runs the same gates plus a gitleaks secret scan

tickets.title: Implement session authentication with scrypt, CSRF and rate limiting
tickets.description: Local email/password login with scrypt hashes, server-side sessions in HTTP-only SameSite cookies, HMAC CSRF tokens and login rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Passwords are stored only as scrypt hashes
Unsafe requests without a valid X-CSRF-Token are rejected with 403
Login is rate limited and failures return a generic 401

tickets.title: Add migration runner, append-only audit table and health checks
tickets.description: Forward-only SQL migrations with checksums, the audit_events table and liveness/readiness endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing an applied migration fails the run
GET /api/health/ready returns 503 when the database is unreachable
Audit rows are written through a single helper that accepts a transaction

tickets.title: Define DealForge role model, permission matrix and role CHECK migration
tickets.description: Replace the placeholder foundation roles with the six PRD actors, add a shared permission matrix used by API guards and web navigation, and constrain users.role in migration 0002.
acceptanceCriteria: ROLES lists exactly the six PRD actors
users.role rejects values outside the actor model
API routes declare permissions resolved through the shared matrix

tickets.title: Write engineering documentation set and ADRs
tickets.description: Architecture, design, data model, OpenAPI contract, threat model, test strategy, operations, planning documents and ADRs 0001-0018.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/README.md indexes every document
OpenAPI lists every PRD section 7 endpoint with x-status and x-ticket
Backlog markdown and JSON agree

tickets.title: Seed development organizations, demo users per role and sample products
tickets.description: Idempotent development-only seed: Helix Managed Services with one user per role, Corvid Industrial Supply as the unrelated tenant, and a few products in each.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed refuses to run with NODE_ENV=production
Running the seed twice produces no duplicates
Every demo login is documented in README

tickets.title: Load the full PRD section 8 demonstration dataset
tickets.description: Extend the seed with 100 catalog items, 8 configurable products, 4 bundles, 2 published price books, 8 pricing rules, 40 customers and 60 quotes across states with approval history.
acceptanceCriteria: Counts match PRD section 8
Atlas Manufacturing exists as a GOLD-tier customer for the golden scenario
./run.sh reset --yes reloads the dataset deterministically

tickets.title: Support multi-role memberships and organization selection at login
tickets.description: Introduce sales_memberships so a user can hold several roles per tenant, and let users with several memberships pick an organization at login.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with SALES_REP and PRICING_MANAGER passes guards for both
Session is bound to exactly one organization
GET /api/v1/auth/organizations lists only the caller's memberships

tickets.title: Build user administration API and screen
tickets.description: Sales admins invite, deactivate and change roles of users in their organization.
acceptanceCriteria: Only SALES_ADMIN can call /api/v1/users endpoints
Deactivated users lose active sessions
Role changes are audited

tickets.title: Build organization pricing settings API and screen
tickets.description: Currency, timezone, default quote expiry, illustrative tax rate, margin floor, manager discount threshold and maximum manual discount per organization.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings are validated as integer bps and ISO 4217 codes
Changes are audited with before/after values
Approval evaluation reads thresholds from these settings

tickets.title: Implement products catalog list, create and get API
tickets.description: Tenant-scoped, role-gated, validated, audited and paginated catalog endpoints with integer minor-unit prices and a unique SKU per organization.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/products paginates and is scoped to the session organization
POST requires catalog:write, returns 201 and writes product.created in the same transaction
Duplicate SKU in the same organization returns 409
Another tenant's product id returns 404

tickets.title: Build product catalog list and create screen
tickets.description: Catalog table with formatted money and list margin, pagination and a create form for admins and pricing managers.
acceptanceCriteria: Decimal input is converted to minor units without floating point
Sales reps see the list without the create form
Server validation and conflict messages are shown to the user

tickets.title: Edit and archive products with immutable quote snapshots
tickets.description: PATCH and archive endpoints plus the product editor screen. Archived products remain readable for historical quotes.
acceptanceCriteria: Archiving sets active=false and is audited
Historical quote lines keep their snapshot after edit or archive
Optimistic concurrency rejects stale edits with 409

tickets.title: Add catalog search and status/category filters
tickets.description: Free-text search on SKU and name plus status and category filters on the catalog list.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters are applied in SQL with indexes
Filter state is reflected in the URL
Pagination totals reflect the filtered set

tickets.title: Import products from CSV with preview, errors and SKU conflict handling
tickets.description: Upload a CSV, preview parsed rows with per-row validation errors, choose skip or update on SKU conflicts and commit in one transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview never writes to the database
Commit is all-or-nothing and audited with row counts
Decimal prices are parsed with parseDecimalToMinor

tickets.title: Build option groups and product options API
tickets.description: Option groups with required flag and min/max selections; options with price and cost deltas.
acceptanceCriteria: Deltas are integer minor units
min_selections <= max_selections is enforced
Endpoints are tenant-scoped and require catalog:write for changes

tickets.title: Implement option incompatibility rules and configuration validator
tickets.description: Pure domain validator for required groups, one-of selections, quantity bounds and mutually incompatible option pairs, used by quote calculation.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing required option is rejected with 422 and a clear reason
Incompatible pair is rejected naming both options
Validator has 100% branch coverage

tickets.title: Build product option and compatibility editor screen
tickets.description: Editor for option groups, options and incompatible pairs on a configurable product.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation errors from the API are shown inline
Only catalog:write roles can open the editor
Keyboard accessible

tickets.title: Build bundles API with one-level components and bundle discount
tickets.description: Bundles with mandatory/optional components, quantity rules and an explicit bundle discount; nesting limited to one level; edits create a new bundle version.
acceptanceCriteria: Nesting a bundle inside a bundle is rejected
Editing a bundle never changes existing quote revisions
Bundle discount is expressed as a BUNDLE pricing rule

tickets.title: Build bundle builder and bundle detail screens
tickets.description: Builder for bundle components and a detail page with per-component pricing.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-component and consolidated totals are shown
Optional components can be toggled
Screen is responsive

tickets.title: Implement money module with integer minor units and basis points
tickets.description: Overflow-guarded integer arithmetic, BigInt-backed percentage and ratio math with a documented half-away-from-zero rounding rule, and exact display formatting and parsing.
acceptanceCriteria: No floating point arithmetic is used for amounts
Rounding boundaries are unit tested
Module has 100% branch coverage

tickets.title: Implement pricing engine with rule selection, stacking, caps and margin
tickets.description: Pure priceQuote(): effective-date and condition eligibility, one rule per category by priority with deterministic tie-break, manual discount last and capped, step-by-step breakdown, separate one-time and recurring totals and gross margin with null for zero revenue.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden scenario totals match reference integer arithmetic
Only one rule per category is applied
Zero revenue yields a null margin
Engine has 100% branch coverage

tickets.title: Implement approval policy evaluator
tickets.description: Pure evaluator returning the ordered approval steps (sales manager, finance) with reasons from manual discount and margin thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: Discount above threshold requires SALES_MANAGER
Margin below floor or cost with zero revenue requires FINANCE
Both triggers produce manager then finance

tickets.title: Build price books API with draft/publish, versions and effective windows
tickets.description: Price books with per-product list and cost prices, draft and published states, immutable published versions and overlap checks on active windows.
acceptanceCriteria: Published price books cannot be edited
Overlapping active windows for the same segment are rejected
Archived products keep their price-book lines

tickets.title: Build price-book editor screen
tickets.description: Editor for price-book lines, validity dates and publishing.
acceptanceCriteria: Publishing requires confirmation and shows the version
Read-only view for published books
Money input uses shared parsing

tickets.title: Build pricing rules API with declarative schema validation
tickets.description: CRUD for rules tied to a price book, validated with ruleIssues() and stored as data snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid rules return 422 with field paths
Rules of a published price book are immutable
Changes are audited

tickets.title: Build discount and price-rule policy editor screen
tickets.description: Editor for rule category, conditions, priority, dates, action and cap.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the restricted condition fields are offered
Server validation errors shown inline
Priority conflicts are explained

tickets.title: Add pricing simulation endpoint
tickets.description: POST /api/v1/pricing/simulate runs priceQuote on a draft line set against a published price book without persisting anything.
acceptanceCriteria: Response contains the full step breakdown
Uses the server date, never client time
Nothing is written to the database

tickets.title: Add configured-option adjustments and illustrative tax estimate to calculation
tickets.description: Feed validated option deltas into the engine and add an illustrative tax estimate excluded from margin and labelled as not tax advice.
acceptanceCriteria: Tax uses the organization bps rate with the documented rounding rule
Tax never changes gross margin
Tax amounts are labelled as estimates

tickets.title: Build customers and contacts API
tickets.description: Customer accounts with tier and status, and contacts per customer.
acceptanceCriteria: Tier feeds CUSTOMER_TIER rule eligibility
Tenant-scoped with 404 across tenants
Changes are audited

tickets.title: Build customer and contact directory screen
tickets.description: List, search and edit customers and their contacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Search by name
Tier and status visible
Responsive table

tickets.title: Build quote families, code allocator, versions schema and create API
tickets.description: quote_families and quote_versions tables, a transactional quote-code allocator and list/create/get endpoints with owner-based visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Quote code is unique per organization and allocated without gaps under concurrency
(family_id, version_number) is unique
Reps see only their own drafts; managers see their team

tickets.title: Build quote list screen
tickets.description: List with owner, stage, expiry, totals and approval status.
acceptanceCriteria: Status badges for low margin, high discount and expired
Filters by status and owner
Paginated

tickets.title: Build new-quote wizard screen
tickets.description: Customer, contact, currency, price book and validity selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Only published price books matching the currency are offered
Validity defaults from organization settings
Creates version 1 in DRAFT

tickets.title: Persist quote lines and server-side calculate endpoint
tickets.description: PATCH lines on a draft version and recalculate with priceQuote from price-book and rule snapshots; client totals are ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Tampered client totals are ignored and recomputed
Line snapshots store unit list and cost
Calculation snapshot JSON is stored on the version

tickets.title: Build quote builder screen
tickets.description: Line items, configuration, quantities, manual discounts, step-by-step breakdown and separate one-time and recurring summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Breakdown shows each pricing step
Recurring amounts labelled per month with term
Warnings for low margin and high discount

tickets.title: Implement quote state machine and server-clock expiry
tickets.description: Enforce DRAFT to SUBMITTED_FOR_APPROVAL to APPROVED to SENT to ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED plus WITHDRAWN with reason, using the server clock.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid transitions return 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION
Expiry uses server time only
Every transition is audited

tickets.title: Clone revisions and reprice into a new version with diff
tickets.description: Clone a version into a new editable draft and reprice against a newer price book, recording before/after differences.
acceptanceCriteria: Source version is unchanged
Approvals are never carried to the new version
Diff lists changed lines and totals

tickets.title: Build quote revision compare page
tickets.description: Side-by-side comparison of two versions of a quote family.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows line, discount and total differences
Highlights approval status per version
Accessible table semantics

tickets.title: Add bundle lines to quotes with component breakdown
tickets.description: Expand a bundle into component lines tagged with the bundle code so BUNDLE rules apply and per-component prices and costs remain visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Component prices and costs are exact
Changing bundle quantity rescales components
Bundle discount applies only to bundle lines

tickets.title: Submit for approval and create sequential approval steps
tickets.description: On submit, recalculate, freeze the version and create approval_steps from evaluateApprovalPolicy in one transaction; standard quotes self-approve.
acceptanceCriteria: Quotes above thresholds cannot be sent before approval
Steps are created in manager then finance order
Submission is audited and notifies approvers

tickets.title: Record approval decisions with idempotency, optimistic locking and no self-approval
tickets.description: Approve, reject or request changes on the current step; reject owner self-approval, stale versions and duplicate decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner approval attempt returns 403
Decision on a superseded version returns 409
Replaying the same decision is idempotent

tickets.title: Build approval inbox screen
tickets.description: Pending steps for the caller's role with margin and exception explanations.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows reasons produced by the policy evaluator
Sorted by age
Only approvals:read roles see it

tickets.title: Build approver decision detail screen
tickets.description: Decision view with pricing breakdown, history and approve/reject/request-changes actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Lines are read-only for approvers
Comment required for reject and request changes
Stale-version errors are explained

tickets.title: Share approved versions with customer contacts through explicit grants
tickets.description: Create and revoke customer_quote_grants for approved versions only.
acceptanceCriteria: Sharing an unapproved version returns 409
Grants are per version and contact
Sharing and revocation are audited

tickets.title: Build printable proposal HTML view and terms
tickets.description: Branded print-optimized proposal with buyer and seller details, lines, separate one-time and recurring totals, validity, terms and quote ID/version.
acceptanceCriteria: No cost or margin appears in the markup
Print stylesheet produces a legible page
Recurring totals are labelled per month

tickets.title: Build customer portal API with redaction, expiry and single acknowledgment
tickets.description: List, view and acknowledge shared versions using a redacted DTO; enforce grants, expiry and one acknowledgment per version.
acceptanceCriteria: Responses never include cost, margin or internal notes
Access without a grant returns 404
Expired versions reject acceptance with renewal instructions

tickets.title: Build customer quote view and accept/reject screen
tickets.description: Customer view of a shared proposal with accept or reject and an optional note.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance is labelled as a demo acknowledgment, not an electronic signature
Outcome and timestamp shown after decision
Expired quotes show renewal guidance

tickets.title: Build sales dashboard API and screen
tickets.description: Draft value, pending approvals, approved vs accepted counts, discount exception rate, average approved margin and quotes expiring soon.
acceptanceCriteria: Figures come from SQL, not fixtures
Quoted revenue is labelled as quoted, never realized
Scoped by role visibility

tickets.title: Build quote reports API
tickets.description: Revenue quoted by month, win rate with explicit denominator, discount trend, frequently quoted SKUs and approval turnaround with filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Win rate denominator is accepted plus rejected
Filters by date, customer, owner and status
No realized revenue is reported

tickets.title: Build reports screen with filters and CSV export
tickets.description: Report views and a CSV export that reflects the same filtered SQL data.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV matches on-screen filtered results
Export requires reports:read
CSV cells are escaped against formula injection

tickets.title: Deliver in-app notifications and background worker
tickets.description: Notifications for approval request, decision, quote expiry and customer acknowledgment, with read state.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications are created in the same transaction as the event
Users see only their own notifications
Mark-as-read is idempotent

tickets.title: Build audit log API and timeline screen
tickets.description: Filterable audit history for prices, rules, revisions, approvals, sharing and acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Only audit:read roles can query
Paginated, newest first
Audit rows are never updated or deleted

tickets.title: Add scheduled quote expiry job
tickets.description: Periodic job that expires SENT versions past valid_until using the server clock and notifies owners.
acceptanceCriteria: Job is idempotent
Expiry transitions are audited
Owner is notified once

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests D-01 to D-04 (quote creation and configuration)
tickets.description: Playwright specs against real PostgreSQL for draft creation, configuration validation and bundles.
acceptanceCriteria: Specs use seeded data, not mocked APIs
Each spec is independent
Runs in CI

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests D-05 to D-11 (pricing, tampering and approval gates)
tickets.description: Playwright specs for discount stacking, tampered totals, approval thresholds, self-approval and stale versions.
acceptanceCriteria: Totals asserted against reference integer arithmetic
Backend denials asserted via API as well as UI
Runs in CI

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests D-12 to D-16 (sharing and customer portal)
tickets.description: Playwright specs for sharing rules, redaction, cross-customer access, expiry and acknowledgment.
acceptanceCriteria: Redaction verified by inspecting API JSON
Direct API access attempts are denied
Runs in CI

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests D-17 to D-21 (history, print, isolation, persistence, reports)
tickets.description: Playwright specs for archived product snapshots, print view, cross-tenant denial, restart persistence and report filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart test restarts the API process
Cross-tenant access returns 404
Runs in CI

tickets.title: Support organization logo upload for proposal branding
tickets.description: Local-disk logo upload with type and size validation used on the printable proposal.
acceptanceCriteria: Only PNG/JPEG/SVG-sanitized up to the configured size
Stored outside the web root with random names
Upload is audited

tickets.title: Run accessibility and responsive audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)
tickets.description: Audit quote builder, approval and customer screens with keyboard and screen-reader checks and fix findings.
acceptanceCriteria: axe checks pass on key screens
All actions reachable by keyboard
Layouts usable at 360px width

tickets.title: Package production container image and deployment pipeline
tickets.description: Multi-stage container image, migrations as a release step and a deployment workflow per docs/operations/deployment.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Image runs as non-root and contains no dev dependencies
Migrations run once per release before traffic shifts
Secrets come from the environment only
